name: SqueezeNeRF
definition: SqueezeNeRF is a memory-efficient NeRF inference method that further factorizes the position-dependent MLP of FastNeRF into three separate MLPs to reduce cache size complexity from O(n^3) to O(n^2).
summary: SqueezeNeRF is a memory-efficient neural rendering method that factorizes the position-dependent MLP into three separate 2D networks to reduce cache size complexity from O(n^3) to O(n^2).
